data.narrative:
Skeleton Technologies is a Series E climate and energy company that has raised €392M to date. The broader sector includes nine peer companies across public and private markets: one public comparable (LNZA) and eight private peers including Helion, Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, and Electric Hydrogen.

The stage-progression method is applicable and yields a $549M implied valuation, using a 1.4x multiplier applied to the $392M total-raised proxy to reflect the typical step-up from Series E to the next financing round. A peer-median approach is not viable; while nine same-sector companies exist, the narrow filters for stage, adjacency, and valuation tier produced insufficient datapoints (fewer than three required comparables), and a broad all-sector median would introduce unacceptable noise.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $466M to $631M, centered on $549M. This range reflects reasonable upside and downside scenarios around the stage-progression median. Key uncertainties include the composition and performance of the comparable set (limited to one public peer), the applicability of the 1.4x multiplier to this specific company's growth trajectory and risk profile, and the absence of direct peer multiples to cross-check the implied value. A later-stage financing or public market entry would provide more granular market signals.
